'''Aphel Jaarn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Born on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], he went to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and joined the [[Exchange]] at sixteen years old, thus "earning" his [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. At the age of nineteen, he was recruited by the [[Eagle]] to work in his [[Eagle's network|terrorist network]] on the same planet, rising high in the ranks, due to his enhancements. The cell connected Jaarn to their communications center, relaying information on the patterns and codes they had. He was killed by an [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]], who infiltrated VerveGen around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
